# TinyML & Edge AI

**Shrink models and run them on microcontrollers, phones, and small boards: pruning, quantization, distillation, TFLite Micro, Edge Impulse, ONNX, and ExecuTorch.**

Level: **Advanced** · 14 steps · 5h 27m of video · Prerequisites: Deep Learning (training a CNN in PyTorch or Keras). Hardware steps use a microcontroller board such as an ESP32-CAM or Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense, a Jetson, or a Raspberry Pi; the rest run on a laptop.

[Track your progress on the website](https://gruheshkurra.github.io/awesome-ai-roadmaps/tinyml-and-edge-ai/) · [All roadmaps](../README.md)

## Build it

- Quantize a small CNN to int8 and report size, latency, and accuracy before and after.
- Train a two-word keyword spotter and run it on a microcontroller board (or the board's simulator).
- Export a PyTorch image classifier to ONNX and compare its speed with ONNX Runtime and plain PyTorch on your laptop.
